existing_evidence.demonstrated_fact: C223016-42-030-east-follow: Temporary lane barrier and designated direction: measured merge from the taper approach into the adjacent open lane. The metadata identifies a measured physical cone barrier and sampled vehicle movement.

runtime_uncertainties: Raw accepted video/trace are not in this export; review relies on source-hashed metadata.
Actual municipal authorization and regulatory meaning are synthetic premises, not physical observations.

evidence_review.method: Read the exact LVMC 11.42.030 text and all four accepted metadata records. Compare east/west follow and oppose cases as existing barrier and travel evidence, while keeping the period, alternative-device and centerline clauses separate. Expected labels and accepted membership do not establish uncovered clauses.

gaps.requirement: Same lane designated in opposite travel directions in separate periods
gaps.why_existing_insufficient: The accepted records do not test a period transition or bind sampled civil time to a changed designation.

gaps.requirement: Markings, signs, barriers and other devices that designate lane direction
gaps.why_existing_insufficient: The accepted records measure cone barriers only; they do not test literal signs, markings, or other devices.

gaps.requirement: Direction designated regardless of roadway centerline
gaps.why_existing_insufficient: The accepted cone cases do not isolate a designation that overrides a contrary centerline inference.
